decisions.decision: Never decode/circumvent protection: one-time tokens (alloha), encrypted playlists (vibix/kinescope {"p":...}), manifests whose segment hosts don't resolve in DNS (rewall/interkh)
decisions.rationale: Same line as DRM; detected via response body of captured manifest (no extra request), marked protected, next player tried

decisions.decision: Quality ladder only for '/NNN.mp4:hls:manifest.m3u8' (Kodik CDN): try higher qualities the same player offers
decisions.rationale: Kodik starts at 360p; 720p exists with same link

decisions.decision: Player preference/misses kept in memory only (module globals in discovery.py)
decisions.rationale: No disk writes without user command

decisions.decision: Custom tool install folder must be owned by user and not group/world-writable; saved to tool-locations.json (0600) only when used
